post.summary: Signs in to the demo company (development servers only; 404 elsewhere).
Turns the customer's portal link on, or replaces it (the old link stops working).

get.summary: The delivery's proof pack: timeline, waiting time, temperature log, photos and signature.

AccountDto.description: Who is signed in. The API turns this into tokens; the app uses it to choose office or driver mode.

AccountLinkDto.description: A one-time link (password reset) to hand over when no email could be sent.

ChangePasswordCommand.description: Signed-in office user. Ends their other sign-ins.

CreateDriverPairingCodeCommand.description: Office: a one-time code a driver types to sign in their phone (valid 24 hours).

CustomerDto.description: A customer as the office sees it, with where things stand.

InvitationPreviewDto.description: What the person opening an invitation link sees before choosing a password.

InviteTeammateCommand.description: Role is "Owner" or "Dispatcher". The link is emailed when possible and always returned to share by hand.

JobOptionsDto.description: Trucks and drivers to choose from when creating a job.

PairDriverCommand.description: Anonymous: a driver's phone exchanges a pairing code for a driver sign-in. Each code works once.

PublicInvoiceDto.description: The customer's invoice page: the invoice plus the delivery's proof. Nothing internal.

PublicStopTimeDto.description: When the truck arrived at and was released from a stop, as recorded by the driver's phone.

PublicTrackingDto.description: What the receiver's tracking page may show: nothing about the driver, the truck or other jobs.

RequestPasswordResetCommand.description: Anonymous. Always succeeds, so nobody can learn which emails have accounts.

ResetPasswordCommand.description: Anonymous: sets a new password from a reset link, ends every other sign-in and signs in.

SaveBillingProfileCommand.description: The company's invoice details, terms, numbering and waiting-time terms.

SignInCommand.description: Anonymous: office sign-in with email and password. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.

SignInOptionsDto.description: What the sign-in screen may offer.

SignUpCommand.description: Anonymous: creates a company account and its first owner.

SuggestedLineDto.description: An extra invoice line the office can add with one tap (e.g. waiting time), already priced.

TeamInvitationDto.description: An invitation not yet accepted. The link is only known when it is created.

UninvoicedJobDto.description: A delivered job waiting for its invoice, with what we remember about the customer.

WaitDto.description:
Waiting at a stop: when the truck arrived and how (GPS, or the driver's tap and how far from the address),
how long it waited, and what is chargeable under the company's terms.
